verdict.rationale: Bun documents a global package cache at ~/.bun/install/cache with hardlinking into node_modules, an offline mode that never touches the network and errors on uncached dependencies, and --frozen-lockfile for reproducible installs. It also claims installs up to 25-30x faster than npm, and community users report large install speedups on Windows. However, the pack contains no documented CI cache-save/restore recipe, so platform engineers must work out the cache-path wiring themselves. missing for 10: an explicit documented CI cache-restore setup (e.g., a CI cache config keyed on bun.lock), independent hands-on corroboration of CI install speed and offline installs.
